# Import data
```{r}
MSD_df <- readxl::read_xlsx("MS1_MSD.xlsx", guess_max = 10000) %>%
  #filter(biomarker != "C-peptide") %>%
  mutate(biomarker = str_replace_all(biomarker, c("TNF-α" = "TNFa", "MCP-1" = "MCP1", "IL-6" = "IL6", "IL-10" = "IL10", "GLP-1" = "GLP1")))

```

```{r add Hp loads}
# Load Hp loads data
MS1_Hp_loads <- read_xlsx("MS1_Hp_loads.xlsx") %>%
  select(mouseID, experiment, total_bact_load, avg_copies, total_Hp_abund, total_DNA_conc, Hp_copies_std) 

# subset Hp loads data by experiment
MS1_Hp_loads_ST <- MS1_Hp_loads %>% 
  filter(experiment == "ST") %>%
  select(-experiment)

# Add Hp loads to MSD dataframe 
MSD_df <- MSD_df %>% 
  inner_join(MS1_Hp_loads_ST, by = "mouseID") 

MSD_df <- MSD_df %>% mutate(Hp_load = ifelse(Hp_copies_std > 1000, "high", "low"))


MSD_df <- MSD_df %>%
  mutate(Hp_load = ifelse(is.na(Hp_load) & treatment == "Ctrl", "Ctrl", Hp_load)) 


#correct WAT weight
MSD_df <- MSD_df %>%
  mutate(new_wat_weight = ifelse(sex == "female" & mouseID != "EO5.1_FR", wat_weight / 2, wat_weight)) # only one WAT depot was collected from EO5.1_FR


```

```{r}
# Count missing values by biomarker and sex
missing_counts <- MSD_df %>%
  group_by(treatment, sex) %>%
  summarise(
    total_missing = sum(is.na(conc_undiluted)),
    IL6_missing = sum(is.na(conc_undiluted) & biomarker == "IL6"),
    Ghrelin_missing = sum(is.na(conc_undiluted) & biomarker == "Ghrelin"),
    leptin_missing = sum(is.na(conc_undiluted) & biomarker == "leptin"),
    Insulin_missing = sum(is.na(conc_undiluted) & biomarker == "Insulin"),
    IL10_missing = sum(is.na(conc_undiluted) & biomarker == "IL10"),
    MCP1_missing = sum(is.na(conc_undiluted) & biomarker == "MCP1"),
    TNF_alpha_missing = sum(is.na(conc_undiluted) & biomarker == "TNFa"),
    GLP1_missing = sum(is.na(conc_undiluted) & biomarker == "GLP1"),
    PYY_missing = sum(is.na(conc_undiluted) & biomarker == "PYY"), 
    Cpeptide_missing = sum(is.na(conc_undiluted) & biomarker == "Cpeptide")
  )

# View the missing counts
print(missing_counts)


#Readings with a value of 0 are replaced with the lowest recorded value for biomarker as detection limit
assay_min_df <- tribble(
  ~biomarker, ~min_conc,
  "Ghrelin",   102.5391,
  "GLP1",     8.710938,
  "IL10",     32.22656,
  "IL6",      25.5127,
  "Insulin",   65.72266,
  "Leptin",    121.582,
  "MCP1",     22.26563,
  "PYY",       40.03906,
  "TNFa",     8.276367
)

MSD_noNAs_df <- MSD_df %>%
  left_join(assay_min_df, by = c("biomarker")) %>%
  mutate(
    conc_noNA = if_else(is.na(conc_undiluted), min_conc, conc_undiluted),
    conc_log10 = log10(conc_noNA),
    Hp_copies_std_log10 = log10(Hp_copies_std)
  )


```



```{r}
#baseline analyses brms, time point b0 3 days before diet change


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Data
# ------------------------------------------------------------
MSD_noNAs_df_b0 <- MSD_noNAs_df %>%
  filter(timepoint == "b0")

df_b0 <- MSD_noNAs_df_b0 %>% 
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Ctrl", "Hp")),
    sex       = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male")),
    biomarker = factor(biomarker)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Fit one model per biomarker
# ------------------------------------------------------------
biomarker_ids_b0 <- unique(df_b0$biomarker)

fit_cytokines_b0_by_biomarker <- biomarker_ids_b0 |>
  set_names() |>
  map(function(bm) {
    dat0_bm <- df_b0 %>% filter(biomarker == bm)

    brm(
      conc_log10 ~ treatment * sex,
      data = dat0_bm,
      family = student(),
      prior = c(
        prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
        prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
      ),
      chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      seed = 123
    )
  })

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Predictions from each model
# ------------------------------------------------------------
preds_b0 <- imap_dfr(fit_cytokines_b0_by_biomarker, function(fit, bm) {
  newdata_bm0 <- expand_grid(
    sex       = levels(fit$data$sex),
    treatment = levels(fit$data$treatment)
  )

  add_epred_draws(
    newdata_bm0,
    fit,
    re_formula = NA
  ) %>%
    mutate(biomarker = bm)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Treatment effect within sex
# ------------------------------------------------------------
summary_probs_b0 <- preds_b0 %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex, treatment, .draw) %>%
  summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred) %>%
  mutate(effect = Hp - Ctrl) %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex) %>%
  summarise(
    median          = median(effect),
    CI_low          = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high         = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low        = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high       = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    prob_Hp_greater = mean(effect > 0),
    is_sig          = (CI_low > 0 | CI_high < 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# biomarkers with at least one 95% CI excluding 0
sig_biomarkers_b0 <- summary_probs_b0 %>%
  group_by(biomarker) %>%
  summarise(any_sig = any(is_sig), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(any_sig) %>%
  pull(biomarker)

summary_probs_b0_sig_only <- summary_probs_b0 %>%
  filter(biomarker %in% sig_biomarkers_b0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Plot function
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_b0_effects <- function(dat) {
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = biomarker, y = median, color = sex)) +
    geom_linerange(
      aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_linerange(
      aes(ymin = CI80_low, ymax = CI80_high),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
      linewidth = 2
    ) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
      size = 2
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "male"   = "#6a0dad",
      "female" = "#b19cd9"
    )) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      y = "Effect estimate (Hp - Ctrl, log10 scale)",
      x = "Biomarker",
      color = "Sex"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Plot all biomarkers
# ------------------------------------------------------------
p_b0_all <- plot_b0_effects(summary_probs_b0)
p_b0_all

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plot only biomarkers with at least one 95% CI excluding 0
# ------------------------------------------------------------
p_b0_sig <- plot_b0_effects(summary_probs_b0_sig_only)
p_b0_sig

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Save
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ggsave("day0_effects_all_markers.jpeg", plot = p_b0_all,
       width = 7, height = 5, units = "in")

ggsave("day0_effects_sig_markers.pdf", plot = p_b0_sig,
       width = 10, height = 8, units = "in")
```



```{r}
#Analyses of rest of the time points, treat time as categorical, to avoid assumption of linear effect

df_lt <- MSD_noNAs_df %>%
  filter(timepoint != "b0")

df_longitudinal_cattime <- df_lt %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Ctrl", "Hp")),
    sex       = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male")),
    diet      = factor(diet),
    biomarker = factor(biomarker),
    timepoint_cat = factor(timepoint, levels = c("b1", "b2", "b3", "b4"))
  )

biomarker_ids_cattime <- unique(df_longitudinal_cattime$biomarker)

fit_models_cattime_by_biomarker <- biomarker_ids_cattime |>
  set_names() |>
  map(function(biomarker_name_cattime) {
    
    df_cattime_biomarker <- df_longitudinal_cattime %>%
      filter(biomarker == biomarker_name_cattime)
    
    brm(
      conc_log10 ~ treatment * sex * diet * timepoint_cat +
        (1 | mouseID),
      data = df_cattime_biomarker,
      family = student(),
      prior = c(
        prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
        prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
        prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
      ),
      chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      seed = 123
    )
  })

preds_cattime_all <- imap_dfr(fit_models_cattime_by_biomarker, function(fit_cattime_biomarker, biomarker_name_cattime) {
  
  fitdata_cattime_biomarker <- fit_cattime_biomarker$data
  
  newdata_cattime_biomarker <- expand_grid(
    sex           = unique(fitdata_cattime_biomarker$sex),
    treatment     = unique(fitdata_cattime_biomarker$treatment),
    diet          = unique(fitdata_cattime_biomarker$diet),
    timepoint_cat = unique(fitdata_cattime_biomarker$timepoint_cat)
  )
  
  add_epred_draws(
    newdata_cattime_biomarker,
    fit_cattime_biomarker,
    re_formula = NA
  ) %>%
    mutate(biomarker = biomarker_name_cattime)
})

preds_cattime_all <- preds_cattime_all %>%
  mutate(biomarker = as.character(biomarker))

time_contrasts_cattime <- preds_cattime_all %>%
  group_by(biomarker, treatment, sex, diet, timepoint_cat, .draw) %>%
  summarise(epred_time = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint_cat, values_from = epred_time) %>%
  mutate(
    contrast_b2_vs_b1 = b2 - b1,
    contrast_b3_vs_b1 = b3 - b1,
    contrast_b3_vs_b2 = b3 - b2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("contrast_"),
    names_to = "time_contrast",
    values_to = "effect"
  ) %>%
  group_by(biomarker, treatment, sex, diet, time_contrast) %>%
  summarise(
    median          = median(effect),
    CI_low          = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high         = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low        = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high       = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    prob_positive   = mean(effect > 0),
    prob_negative   = mean(effect < 0),
    has_time_effect = (CI_low > 0 | CI_high < 0),
    has_time_effect80 = (CI80_low > 0 | CI80_high < 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

preds_cattime_avgtime <- preds_cattime_all

eff_main_treat_cattime_avg <- preds_cattime_avgtime %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex, treatment, .draw) %>%
  summarise(epred_avgtime = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred_avgtime) %>%
  mutate(effect = Hp - Ctrl) %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex) %>%
  summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "Main Effects", label = "Treatment")

eff_main_diet_cattime_avg <- preds_cattime_avgtime %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex, diet, .draw) %>%
  summarise(epred_avgtime = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = epred_avgtime) %>%
  mutate(effect = HFD - CD) %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex) %>%
  summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "Main Effects", label = "Diet")


eff_interaction_cattime_avg <- preds_cattime_avgtime %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
  summarise(epred_avgtime = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(treatment, diet), values_from = epred_avgtime) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_HFD = Hp_HFD - Ctrl_HFD,
    diff_CD  = Hp_CD - Ctrl_CD,
    effect   = diff_HFD - diff_CD
  ) %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex) %>%
  summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "Interaction", label = "Interaction")


eff_simple_treat_cattime_avg <- preds_cattime_avgtime %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
  summarise(epred_avgtime = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred_avgtime) %>%
  mutate(effect = Hp - Ctrl) %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex, diet) %>%
  summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    type  = "Simple Effects",
    label = paste("Treatment in", diet)
  )


eff_simple_diet_cattime_avg <- preds_cattime_avgtime %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
  summarise(epred_avgtime = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = epred_avgtime) %>%
  mutate(effect = HFD - CD) %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    type  = "Simple Effects",
    label = paste("Diet in", treatment)
  )


plot_data_cattime_avg <- bind_rows(
  eff_main_treat_cattime_avg,
  eff_main_diet_cattime_avg,
  eff_interaction_cattime_avg,
  eff_simple_treat_cattime_avg,
  eff_simple_diet_cattime_avg
) %>%
  mutate(
    is_sig = (CI_low > 0 | CI_high < 0),
    is_sig80 = (CI80_low > 0 | CI80_high < 0),
    label = factor(
      label,
      levels = c(
        "Diet in Hp", "Diet in Ctrl",
        "Treatment in HFD", "Treatment in CD",
        "Interaction",
        "Diet", "Treatment"
      )
    ),
    type = factor(
      type,
      levels = c("Main Effects", "Interaction", "Simple Effects")
    )
  )



#make the daily plots

make_day_effects_from_cattime_model <- function(preds_cattime_input, day_label) {
  
  preds_cattime_day <- preds_cattime_input %>%
    filter(timepoint_cat == day_label)
  
  # A. Main Effect: Treatment
  eff_main_treat_cattime_day <- preds_cattime_day %>%
    group_by(biomarker, sex, treatment, .draw) %>%
    summarise(epred_day = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred_day) %>%
    mutate(effect = Hp - Ctrl) %>%
    group_by(biomarker, sex) %>%
    summarise(
      median    = median(effect),
      CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
      CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
      CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
      CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(type = "Main Effects", label = "Treatment")
  
  # B. Main Effect: Diet
  eff_main_diet_cattime_day <- preds_cattime_day %>%
    group_by(biomarker, sex, diet, .draw) %>%
    summarise(epred_day = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = epred_day) %>%
    mutate(effect = HFD - CD) %>%
    group_by(biomarker, sex) %>%
    summarise(
      median    = median(effect),
      CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
      CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
      CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
      CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(type = "Main Effects", label = "Diet")
  
  # C. Treatment × Diet interaction
  eff_interaction_cattime_day <- preds_cattime_day %>%
    group_by(biomarker, sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
    summarise(epred_day = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = c(treatment, diet), values_from = epred_day) %>%
    mutate(
      diff_HFD = Hp_HFD - Ctrl_HFD,
      diff_CD  = Hp_CD - Ctrl_CD,
      effect   = diff_HFD - diff_CD
    ) %>%
    group_by(biomarker, sex) %>%
    summarise(
      median    = median(effect),
      CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
      CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
      CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
      CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(type = "Interaction", label = "Interaction")
  
  # D. Simple Effects: Treatment within Diet
  eff_simple_treat_cattime_day <- preds_cattime_day %>%
    group_by(biomarker, sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
    summarise(epred_day = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred_day) %>%
    mutate(effect = Hp - Ctrl) %>%
    group_by(biomarker, sex, diet) %>%
    summarise(
      median    = median(effect),
      CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
      CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
      CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
      CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      type  = "Simple Effects",
      label = paste("Treatment in", diet)
    )
  
  # E. Simple Effects: Diet within Treatment
  eff_simple_diet_cattime_day <- preds_cattime_day %>%
    group_by(biomarker, sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
    summarise(epred_day = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = epred_day) %>%
    mutate(effect = HFD - CD) %>%
    group_by(biomarker, sex, treatment) %>%
    summarise(
      median    = median(effect),
      CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
      CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
      CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
      CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      type  = "Simple Effects",
      label = paste("Diet in", treatment)
    )
  
  plot_data_cattime_day <- bind_rows(
    eff_main_treat_cattime_day,
    eff_main_diet_cattime_day,
    eff_interaction_cattime_day,
    eff_simple_treat_cattime_day,
    eff_simple_diet_cattime_day
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      timepoint_cat = day_label,
      is_sig = (CI_low > 0 | CI_high < 0),
      is_sig80 = (CI80_low > 0 | CI80_high < 0),
      label = factor(
        label,
        levels = c(
          "Diet in Hp", "Diet in Ctrl",
          "Treatment in HFD", "Treatment in CD",
          "Interaction",
          "Diet", "Treatment"
        )
      ),
      type = factor(
        type,
        levels = c("Main Effects", "Interaction", "Simple Effects")
      )
    )
  
  plot_data_cattime_day
}

day_levels_cattime <- levels(df_longitudinal_cattime$timepoint_cat)

plot_data_cattime_by_day <- set_names(day_levels_cattime) |>
  map(~ make_day_effects_from_cattime_model(preds_cattime_all, .x))



plot_data_cattime_simple_all_days <- imap_dfr(
  plot_data_cattime_by_day,
  function(plot_df_cattime_day, day_label) {
    plot_df_cattime_day %>%
      mutate(timepoint_cat = day_label)
  }
) %>%
  filter(type == "Simple Effects") %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_cat = factor(timepoint_cat, levels = c("b1", "b2", "b3", "b4")),
    biomarker = factor(biomarker),
    label = factor(
      label,
      levels = c(
        "Diet in Hp", "Diet in Ctrl",
        "Treatment in HFD", "Treatment in CD"
      )
    )
  )

plot_data_cattime_simple_all_days <- plot_data_cattime_simple_all_days %>%
  mutate(
    color_group = case_when(
      is_sig80 & sex == "female" ~ "female_sig",
      is_sig80 & sex == "male"   ~ "male_sig",
      !is_sig80 & sex == "female" ~ "female_nonsig",
      !is_sig80 & sex == "male"   ~ "male_nonsig"
    )
  )

p_simpleeffects_by_day <- ggplot(
  plot_data_cattime_simple_all_days,
  aes(x = label, y = median, color = color_group)
) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = CI80_low, ymax = CI80_high),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    linewidth = 1.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.1, 1.6)) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(
  rows = vars(biomarker),
  cols = vars(timepoint_cat),
  labeller = labeller(
    timepoint_cat = c(
      b1 = "One week on diet, 4h fast",
      b2 = "Two weeks on diet, 4h fast",
      b3 = "Three weeks on diet, 4h fast",
      b4 = "Four weeks on diet, 12h fast"
    )
  )
) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      female_sig    = "#b19cd9",
      male_sig      = "#6a0dad",
      female_nonsig = "#d9d9d9",

    )
  ) +
```

```{r}
#WAT weight figure

# --- 1. FIT MODEL, select random biomarker for filtering  ---
MSD_noNAs_df_b4_wat <- MSD_noNAs_df %>%
  filter(timepoint == "b4", biomarker == "Ghrelin", !is.na(new_wat_weight)) 

df_b4_WAT <- MSD_noNAs_df_b4_wat %>% 
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Ctrl", "Hp")),
    sex       = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male")),
    diet      = factor(diet, levels = c("CD", "HFD"))
  )
   
fit_wat_b4 <- brm(
  new_wat_weight ~ treatment * sex * diet,
  data = df_b4_WAT,
  family = student(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  backend = "cmdstanr", seed = 123
)


# --- 2. PREDICTIONS ---
newdata_b4_WAT <- expand_grid(
  sex       = unique(df_b4_WAT$sex),
  treatment = unique(df_b4_WAT$treatment),
  diet      = unique(df_b4_WAT$diet)
)

preds_b4_WAT <- add_epred_draws(newdata_b4_WAT, fit_wat_b4)

# --- 3. CALCULATE EFFECTS AS PERCENTAGE CHANGE ---
# Formula: ((Test / Reference) - 1) * 100

# A. Main Effects (Pooled)
eff_main_treat <- preds_b4_WAT %>%
  group_by(sex, treatment, .draw) %>%
  summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred) %>%
  # CHANGE: Calculate % Change
  mutate(effect = (Hp / Ctrl - 1) * 100) %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(median = median(effect), CI_low = quantile(effect, 0.025), CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(type = "Main Effects", label = "Treatment")

eff_main_diet <- preds_b4_WAT %>%
  group_by(sex, diet, .draw) %>%
  summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = epred) %>%
  #  Calculate % Change
  mutate(effect = (HFD / CD - 1) * 100) %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(median = median(effect), CI_low = quantile(effect, 0.025), CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(type = "Main Effects", label = "Diet")

# C. Simple Effects
eff_simple_treat <- preds_b4_WAT %>%
  group_by(sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
  summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred) %>%
  #  Calculate % Change
  mutate(effect = (Hp / Ctrl - 1) * 100) %>%
  group_by(sex, diet) %>%
  summarise(median = median(effect), CI_low = quantile(effect, 0.025), CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(type = "Simple Effects", label = paste("Treatment in", diet))

eff_simple_diet <- preds_b4_WAT %>%
  group_by(sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
  summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = epred) %>%
  # Calculate % Change
  mutate(effect = (HFD / CD - 1) * 100) %>%
  group_by(sex, treatment) %>%
  summarise(median = median(effect), CI_low = quantile(effect, 0.025), CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(type = "Simple Effects", label = paste("Diet in", treatment))

# B. Interaction (Difference of Percentages)
eff_interaction <- preds_b4_WAT %>%
  group_by(sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
  summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(treatment, diet), values_from = epred) %>%
  mutate(
    # % Effect of Hp in HFD
    pct_HFD = (Hp_HFD / Ctrl_HFD - 1) * 100,
    # % Effect of Hp in CD
    pct_CD  = (Hp_CD / Ctrl_CD - 1) * 100,
    # Interaction = Difference in % points
    effect  = pct_HFD - pct_CD
  ) %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(median = median(effect), CI_low = quantile(effect, 0.025), CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(type = "Interaction", label = "Interaction")

# --- 4. COMBINE AND ORDER ---
plot_df_wat <- bind_rows(eff_main_treat, eff_main_diet, eff_interaction, eff_simple_treat, eff_simple_diet) %>%
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = c(
      "Diet in Hp", "Diet in Ctrl", 
      "Treatment in HFD", "Treatment in CD", 
      "Interaction",
      "Diet", "Treatment"
    )),
    type = factor(type, levels = c("Main Effects", "Interaction", "Simple Effects"))
  )

# --- 5. PLOT ---
WAT_plot <- ggplot(plot_df_wat, aes(x = label, y = median, color = sex)) +
  
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high, shape = type), 
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.8) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("female" = "#b19cd9", "male" = "#6a0dad")) +
  
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Main Effects"   = 16, 
    "Interaction"    = 18, 
    "Simple Effects" = 15  
  )) +
  
  # --- CONTROL LEGEND ORDER HERE ---
  guides(
    shape = guide_legend(order = 1), # Effect Type on Top
    color = guide_legend(order = 2)  # Sex Below
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(color = "black"),
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold"),
    
    # --- STACK LEGENDS VERTICALLY ---
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.box         = "vertical",  # Stacks the two legends
    legend.margin      = margin(t = 0, b = 0, unit = "pt") # tighter spacing
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "", 
    y = "Effect Estimate (% change)", 
    color = "Sex", shape = "Effect Type"
  )

WAT_plot <- WAT_plot +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 10,
      r = 30,  
      b = 10,
      l = 10,
      unit = "pt"
    )
  )

# Save
ggsave("WAT_effects_percent.jpeg", plot = WAT_plot, width = 6.5, height = 5, units = "in")

WAT_plot
```

```{r}
#final time point at sacrifice, is there an effect of Hp_load and WAT weight?

MSD_noNAs_df_b4 <- MSD_noNAs_df %>%
  filter(timepoint == "b4")

df_b4 <- MSD_noNAs_df_b4 %>% 
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Ctrl", "Hp")),
    sex       = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male")),
    biomarker = factor(biomarker),
    diet = factor(diet)
  )

df_inf <- df_b4 %>%
  filter(treatment == "Hp")

biomarker_ids <- unique(df_inf$biomarker)

fit_cytokines_b4_by_biomarker_HpWAT <- biomarker_ids |>
  set_names() |>
  map(function(bm) {

    dat_bm <- df_inf %>%
      filter(biomarker == bm) %>%
      mutate(
        sex  = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male")),
        diet = factor(diet, levels = c("CD", "HFD")),
        Hp_z  = as.numeric(scale(Hp_copies_std_log10)),
        WAT_z = as.numeric(scale(new_wat_weight))
      )

    brm(
      conc_log10 ~ sex * diet + Hp_z * sex * diet + WAT_z,
      data = dat_bm,
      family = student(),
      prior = c(
        prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
        prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
      ),
      chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      seed = 123
    )
  })

preds_Hp_inf <- imap_dfr(fit_cytokines_b4_by_biomarker_HpWAT, function(fit, bm) {

  dat_bm <- fit$data

  Hp_vals <- seq(
    min(dat_bm$Hp_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dat_bm$Hp_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 50
  )

  newdata_bm_Hp <- expand_grid(
    sex  = levels(dat_bm$sex),
    diet = levels(dat_bm$diet),
    Hp_z = Hp_vals,
    WAT_z = 0
  )

  add_epred_draws(
    object = fit,
    newdata = newdata_bm_Hp,
    re_formula = NA
  ) %>%
    mutate(biomarker = bm)
})

preds_Hp_inf <- imap_dfr(fit_cytokines_b4_by_biomarker_HpWAT, function(fit, bm) {

  dat_bm <- fit$data

  Hp_vals <- seq(
    min(dat_bm$Hp_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dat_bm$Hp_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 50
  )

  newdata_bm_Hp <- expand_grid(
    sex  = levels(dat_bm$sex),
    diet = levels(dat_bm$diet),
    Hp_z = Hp_vals,
    WAT_z = 0
  )

  add_epred_draws(
    object = fit,
    newdata = newdata_bm_Hp,
    re_formula = NA
  ) %>%
    mutate(biomarker = bm)
})

preds_Hp_inf_sum <- preds_Hp_inf %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex, diet, Hp_z) %>%
  summarise(
    median    = median(.epred),
    CI_low    = quantile(.epred, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(.epred, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(.epred, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(.epred, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_Hp_lines <- ggplot(
  preds_Hp_inf_sum,
  aes(x = Hp_z, y = median, color = diet, fill = diet)
) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high), alpha = 0.12, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_grid(sex ~ biomarker, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CD" = "#0072B2", "HFD" = "#D55E00")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CD" = "#0072B2", "HFD" = "#D55E00")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Hp load (z-score)",
    y = "Predicted biomarker concentration (log10)",
    color = "Diet",
    fill = "Diet"
  )

p_Hp_lines

Hp_slopes_inf <- preds_Hp_inf %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex, diet, .draw) %>%
  arrange(Hp_z, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    Hp_min = first(Hp_z),
    Hp_max = last(Hp_z),
    pred_min = first(.epred),
    pred_max = last(.epred),
    slope = (pred_max - pred_min) / (Hp_max - Hp_min),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(biomarker, sex, diet) %>%
  summarise(
    median    = median(slope),
    CI_low    = quantile(slope, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(slope, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(slope, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(slope, 0.90),
    prob_pos  = mean(slope > 0),
    prob_neg  = mean(slope < 0),
    is_sig80  = (CI80_low > 0 | CI80_high < 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      paste(sex, diet, sep = " | "),
      levels = c(
        "female | CD",
        "female | HFD",
        "male | CD",
        "male | HFD"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
      "Hp | male | CD",
      "Hp | male | HFD",
      "WAT"
    )),
    color_group = case_when(
      is_sig80 ~ "wat_sig",
      !is_sig80 ~ "wat_nonsig"
    )
  )

# combine
combined_slopes_df <- bind_rows(Hp_plot_df, WAT_plot_df)


# Hp rows
Hp_plot_df <- Hp_slopes_inf %>%
  mutate(
    predictor = "Hp load",
    effect_label = factor(
      paste("Hp |", sex, "|", diet),
      levels = c(
        "Hp | female | CD",
        "Hp | female | HFD",
        "Hp | male | CD",
        "Hp | male | HFD",
        "WAT"
      )
    ),
    color_group = case_when(
      is_sig80 & sex == "female" ~ "female_sig",
      is_sig80 & sex == "male"   ~ "male_sig",
      !is_sig80 & sex == "female" ~ "female_nonsig",
      !is_sig80 & sex == "male"   ~ "male_nonsig"
    )
  )

# WAT row
WAT_plot_df <- WAT_slopes_inf %>%
  mutate(
    predictor = "WAT",
    sex = "all",
    diet = "all",
    effect_label = factor("WAT", levels = c(
      "Hp | female | CD",
      "Hp | female | HFD",
      "Hp | male | CD",
      "Hp | male | HFD",
      "WAT"
    )),
    color_group = case_when(
      is_sig80 ~ "wat_sig",
      !is_sig80 ~ "wat_nonsig"
    )
  )

# combine
combined_slopes_df <- bind_rows(Hp_plot_df, WAT_plot_df)



# Hp rows
Hp_plot_df <- Hp_slopes_inf %>%
  mutate(
    predictor = "Hp load",
    effect_label = factor(
      paste("Hp |", sex, "|", diet),
      levels = c(
        "Hp | female | CD",
        "Hp | female | HFD",
        "Hp | male | CD",
        "Hp | male | HFD",
        "WAT"
      )
    ),
    color_group = case_when(
      is_sig80 & sex == "female" ~ "female_sig",
      is_sig80 & sex == "male"   ~ "male_sig",
      !is_sig80 & sex == "female" ~ "female_nonsig",
      !is_sig80 & sex == "male"   ~ "male_nonsig"
    )
  )

# WAT row
WAT_plot_df <- WAT_slopes_inf %>%
  mutate(
    predictor = "WAT",
    sex = "all",
    diet = "all",
    effect_label = factor("WAT", levels = c(
      "Hp | female | CD",
      "Hp | female | HFD",
      "Hp | male | CD",
      "Hp | male | HFD",
      "WAT"
    )),
    color_group = case_when(
      is_sig80 ~ "wat_sig",
      !is_sig80 ~ "wat_nonsig"
    )
  )

# combine
combined_slopes_df <- bind_rows(Hp_plot_df, WAT_plot_df)

combined_forest_plot <- ggplot(
  combined_slopes_df,
  aes(x = effect_label, y = median, color = color_group)
) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = CI80_low, ymax = CI80_high),
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ biomarker, nrow = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      female_sig    = "#b19cd9",
      male_sig      = "#6a0dad",
      female_nonsig = "#d9d9d9",
      male_nonsig   = "#8c8c8c",
      wat_sig       = "#0072B2",
      wat_nonsig    = "#9ecae1"
    ),
    labels = c(
      female_sig    = "Hp female (CI80 ≠ 0)",
      male_sig      = "Hp male (CI80 ≠ 0)",
      female_nonsig = "Hp female (CI80 overlaps 0)",
      male_nonsig   = "Hp male (CI80 overlaps 0)",
      wat_sig       = "WAT (CI80 ≠ 0)",
      wat_nonsig    = "WAT (CI80 overlaps 0)"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Slope (change in log10 biomarker per 1 SD increase)",
    color = "Predictor / Evidence"
  )
```

```{r}
#testing which model to go with

df_inf_IL6 <- df_b4 %>%
  filter(treatment == "Hp", biomarker == "IL6") %>%
  mutate(
    sex  = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male")),
    diet = factor(diet, levels = c("CD", "HFD")),
    Hp_z  = as.numeric(scale(Hp_copies_std_log10)),
    WAT_z = as.numeric(scale(new_wat_weight))
  )

df_inf_Ghre <- df_b4 %>%
  filter(treatment == "Hp", biomarker == "Ghrelin") %>%
  mutate(
    sex  = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male")),
    diet = factor(diet, levels = c("CD", "HFD")),
    Hp_z  = as.numeric(scale(Hp_copies_std_log10)),
    WAT_z = as.numeric(scale(new_wat_weight))
  )

df_inf_Lep <- df_b4 %>%
  filter(treatment == "Hp", biomarker == "Leptin") %>%
  mutate(
    sex  = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male")),
    diet = factor(diet, levels = c("CD", "HFD")),
    Hp_z  = as.numeric(scale(Hp_copies_std_log10)),
    WAT_z = as.numeric(scale(new_wat_weight))
  )

fit_base <- brm(
  conc_log10 ~ sex * diet + Hp_z * sex * diet + WAT_z,
  data = df_inf_Lep,
  family = student(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  seed = 123
)

fit_wat_sex <- brm(
  conc_log10 ~ sex * diet + Hp_z * sex * diet + WAT_z * sex,
  data = df_inf_Lep,
  family = student(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  seed = 123
)

fit_wat_diet <- brm(
  conc_log10 ~ sex * diet + Hp_z * sex * diet + WAT_z * diet,
  data = df_inf_Lep,
  family = student(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  seed = 123
)

fit_wat_full <- brm(
  conc_log10 ~ sex * diet + Hp_z * sex * diet + WAT_z * sex * diet,
  data = df_inf_Lep,
  family = student(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  seed = 123
)

library(loo)

loo_base     <- loo(fit_base, moment_match = TRUE)
loo_wat_sex  <- loo(fit_wat_sex, moment_match = TRUE)
loo_wat_diet <- loo(fit_wat_diet, moment_match = TRUE)
loo_wat_full <- loo(fit_wat_full, moment_match = TRUE)

loo_compare(
  loo_base,
  loo_wat_sex,
  loo_wat_diet,
  loo_wat_full
)
```
